title: AI Factory engagement input (contract C1)
description: Mirror of the Management App's shared engagement-input schema (engagementInputSchema, schemaVersion 1): the result of the MCP tool replatform_get_engagement_input. The Wizard's answers for steps 1 to 3 and the source reference with its SHA. Read it first and ask the owner only for the fields listed in missing. It is kept in step with the pinned contracts/mgmt/engagement-input.schema.json.

specification.description: The solution specification the answers come from, newest revision first. Null when the Wizard's answers were never saved. A draft is the Wizard's answers so far, not an approval.

edge.description: The edge in front of the web apps and with it the tiers (2026-11-10). Absent when the answers predate the tiers: every environment then has an App Gateway. With it, a Basic environment has no gateway and Standard and Premium have this WAF edge (edgeFor). Copy it to ai-factory.json as given; never invent it.

existingId.description: The resource ID of the shared App Gateway or Front Door profile an existing edge names. Copy it as given; never guess one.

allowedIps.description: The addresses the environments without a gateway are narrowed to.

foundry.description: Foundry Premium's AI gateway (2026-11-10) as the specification holds it: new, or an existing API Management instance (existingId, the principalId of its managed identity, its tier). Absent when no gateway was chosen. Copy it to ai-factory.json as foundry.gateway.

database.description: The database engine (2026-11-10). Absent means PostgreSQL. cosmos-nosql is Cosmos DB for NoSQL, serverless, Entra only: not a drop-in, the app code changes.

platformKinds.description: What the solution is (2026-11-11): azure-apps, fabric, power-platform, or a mix. Absent means azure-apps only. Without azure-apps the solution may have no app: the agent writes a platform plan, not a rebuild.

addressSpace.description: The VNet address space the order sets (2026-11-11). Absent: the template default for the zone. Copy it to ai-factory.json as landingZone.addressSpace; never ask for it again.

registryAccess.description: Yellow's registry access (2026-11-11): private (Premium, private endpoint) or public (Basic, Entra ID and RBAC only). Absent: private, or not the order's own registry. Copy it as landingZone.registry.access; never choose it.

sharedResources.description: Every shared platform resource the order references instead of creating (2026-11-11), as resource IDs, and the shared resource group named for them (information only). Never created or written to; the app references them. Absent when nothing is shared. Never infer one that is not here.

source.description: The newest upload of the solution: what it is and its hash, never its content.

missing.description: The answers still open, in this fixed order. They are the only questions the agent may still put to the owner.

code.description: The Wizard's code; empty until the answers are saved.
